ic_name: DALI (Digital Addressable Lighting Interface, IEC 62386 via TI SLAA422A)
base_address: Not applicable in the memory-mapped-peripheral sense. DALI defines a set of named variables (Actual Level, Power On Level, Min/Max Level, Fade Rate/Time, Short Address, Group membership, Scene 0..15, Random Address, Fast Fade Time, Failure Status, Operating Mode, Dimming Curve, DTR, DTR1, DTR2, Search Address, plus device-type extensions) that the control gear shall expose via the DALI command set. In SLAA422A those variables are stored in the MSP430 information-memory flash and shadowed in RAM per Table 2 of the report.

data_tables.name: Control gear configuration variables
function_codes: 0xE4 STORE DTR AS FAST FADE TIME

data_tables.name: Memory bank locations (DT-specific)
function_codes: 0xC7 WRITE MEMORY LOCATION (unsupported in TI app)

registers.name: Power_On_Level
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS POWER ON LEVEL (0x2D) / read via QUERY POWER ON LEVEL
registers.description: Arc power level loaded after every power-up of the control gear.

registers.name: System_Failure_Level
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS SYSTEM FAILURE LEVEL (0x2C) / read via query
registers.description: Arc power level applied when the bus voltage is lost for longer than the protected interval.

registers.name: Minimum_Level
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS MIN LEVEL (0x2B) / read via QUERY MIN LEVEL
registers.description: Lower clamp for Actual Level. Must be ≥ PHYS_MIN_LEVEL.

registers.name: Maximum_Level
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS MAX LEVEL (0x2A) / read via QUERY MAX LEVEL
registers.description: Upper clamp for Actual Level. Must be ≤ 254.

registers.name: Fade_Rate
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS FADE RATE (0x2F) / read via QUERY FADE TIME/RATE
registers.description: Selects one of 15 fade-rate codes 1..15 (358..2.8 steps/s); used by UP/DOWN.

registers.name: Fade_Time
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS FADE TIME (0x2E) / read via QUERY FADE TIME/RATE
registers.description: Selects one of 16 fade-time codes 0..15 (≤ 25 ms..16 s); used by DAPC/scene.

registers.name: Short_Address
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS SHORT ADDRESS (0x80) / read via QUERY SHORT ADDRESS (special)
registers.description: Encoded 0AAAAAA1 (short address 0..63) or 0xFF if unassigned.

registers.name: Group_0_7
registers.access: DALI write via ADD/REMOVE FROM GROUP (0x60..0x67/0x70..0x77) / read via QUERY GROUPS 0-7 (0xC0)
registers.description: Bitmask: bit n = 1 if gear belongs to group n (0..7).

registers.name: Group_8_15
registers.access: DALI write via ADD/REMOVE FROM GROUP (0x68..0x6F/0x78..0x7F) / read via QUERY GROUPS 8-15 (0xC1)
registers.description: Bitmask: bit n = 1 if gear belongs to group n+8 (8..15).

registers.name: Scene_0_15
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS SCENE n (0x40..0x4F) / REMOVE FROM SCENE n (0x50..0x5F) / read via QUERY SCENE LEVEL n (0xB0..0xBF)
registers.description: Per-scene stored arc power level.

registers.name: Random_Address_H
registers.access: internal — generated by RANDOMIZE (special); compared against Search Address via COMPARE/WITHDRAW
registers.description: MSB of the 24-bit Random Address used by the addressing iteration.

registers.name: Random_Address_M
registers.access: internal
registers.description: Middle byte of the 24-bit Random Address.

registers.name: Random_Address_L
registers.access: internal
registers.description: LSB of the 24-bit Random Address.

registers.name: Fast_Fade_Time
registers.access: DALI write via STORE DTR AS FAST FADE TIME (0xE4) / read via QUERY FAST FADE TIME (0xFC)
registers.description: Fast-fade time selector for the device-type-specific 'fast' fade ramp.

registers.name: Failure_Status
registers.access: internal status latched on each detected fault; read via QUERY commands 0x92/0x94
registers.description: Latched fault flags: lamp failure, lamp power on/off mismatch, limit error, etc.

registers.name: Operating_Mode
registers.access: internal / vendor-specific
registers.description: Device-type-specific operating mode (e.g. PWM vs CCR vs constant-current for LED driver).

registers.name: Dimming_Curve
registers.access: internal — vendor-defined (SLAA422A does not allow updating this via DALI commands 224..227)
registers.description: Selected dimming curve (0 = logarithmic per IEC 62386, 1 = linear, vendor-specific).

registers.name: DTR
registers.access: DALI special command DTR (0xA3) / auto-incremented by some memory ops
registers.description: Scratchpad register loaded by special command DTR (0xA3); argument for STORE DTR AS ... commands.

registers.name: DTR1
registers.access: DALI special command DTR1 (0xC3)
registers.description: Memory-bank offset (high byte) for READ/WRITE MEMORY LOCATION.

registers.name: DTR2
registers.access: DALI special command DTR2 (0xC5)
registers.description: Memory-bank index for READ/WRITE MEMORY LOCATION.

registers.name: Search_Address
registers.access: DALI special commands SEARCH ADDRESS H/M/L (0xB1/0xB3/0xB5)
registers.description: Comparison register used by COMPARE/WITHDRAW during the addressing iteration.

registers.name: Actual_Level
registers.access: internal — updated by direct/indirect commands and the fade ISR; read via QUERY ACTUAL LEVEL (0xA0)
registers.description: Current logical arc power level; index into the PWM look-up table.

memory_bank_locations_IEC62386_102_bank0.name: GTIN bytes [0..5] of Control Gear (6 bytes, locations 3..8)
Number of Logical Control Device Units
Number of Logical Control Gear Units
Index of this Logical Control Gear Unit

diagnostic_counters: QUERY STATUS — 8 device-status bits (gear status, lamp failure, lamp on, limit error, fade running, reset state, missing short address, power failure)
QUERY LAMP FAILURE 0x92 — 0xFF if lamp has failed
QUERY LAMP POWER ON 0x93 — 0xFF if Actual Level > 0
QUERY LIMIT ERROR 0x94 — 0xFF if last requested level was outside Min/Max
QUERY RESET STATE 0x95 — 0xFF if reset state pending
QUERY MISSING SHORT ADDRESS 0x96 — 0xFF if no short address assigned
notes: DALI is a protocol, not a chip. The 'register map' above describes the canonical persistent and runtime variables exposed by every IEC 62386-102 control gear and the optional device-type variables added by IEC 62386-207 (LED). The exact in-chip storage is implementation-defined; the SLAA422A TI report places these variables in MSP430 information-memory flash per Table 2 (32-byte layout) and shadows them in RAM at runtime.
